description: Genre pack: the site-of-the-day aesthetic — the page as a film projected on studio print. Warm paper canvas, near-black ink type, one vivid electric-blue accent, grotesk display, alternating scene canvases, a scrubbed index counter, text-dissolve pins, and a drag-driven card carousel. For portfolios, product launches, agencies, and any brief that wants premium scroll-driven storytelling. Requires taste-gsap for the implementation. Stack on the design-taste core skill.
